data.title: Meta's $145 Billion AI Spending Plan Raises Credit Concerns as S&P Global Turns Outlook Negative: ‘Less Certain That It Will Curtail Its Spending’
data.description: S&P Global cuts Meta’s credit outlook to negative as rising AI spending and cash flow pressures raise concerns over leverage.

data.title: Trump Reveals US Probing $6.3 Billion Binance Crypto Hack As North Korea-Linked Hackers Come Under Suspicion, Says Exchange Told Officials Situation Is ‘Pretty Much Under Control’
data.description: Trump says his administration is investigating Binance’s $6.3 billion crypto hack as North Korean hackers face suspicion.

data.title: Meta, TikTok and X Lose UK Court Fight Over Requests for Social Media Safety Data
data.description: On Friday, Meta Platforms Inc. (NASDAQ: META), TikTok and X lost their legal challenge in London's High Court against Ofcom over the British regulator's requests for information under the Online Safety Act.

data.description: Trump weighs renewed Iran strikes as the Pentagon reinforces its Middle East defenses and Vance pursues diplomacy.

data.title: US Clears $2.1 Billion Lockheed Martin Patriot Missile Sale to Ukraine, But Zelenskyy Says Deliveries Could Take Years: ‘There Is Real Danger’
data.description: The U.S. approves a $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine, funded by Canada, Germany, Norway and EU-backed financing.
